cross_verification.note_en: The official Timor-Leste Ministry of Justice document 'Rekezitus trata Pasaporte' (Requirements for processing a passport, referencing Decreto-Lei No. 52/2016 of 28 December, Direção Nacional de Identificação Civil e Registo Criminal, Departamento de Passaportes e Passes de Fronteira — https://mj.gov.tl/files/2023/Rekezitus_trata_passporte_TL.pdf) lists only identity documents for e-Passport applications: a valid Bilete Identidade (national ID card) for adults; birth certificate, marriage certificate of parents, and parents' ID cards for minors. It does NOT list a self-submitted photograph among the requirements at all, and states fees/turnaround (USD 50/10 business days standard, up to USD 100/1 business day urgent). This absence suggests Timor-Leste's e-Passport photo may be captured biometrically on-site at the passport office, similar to Thailand's process (see th-passport.json), but this is an inference from an omission, not an explicit statement, so it is NOT recorded as a verified field. No separate official Ministry of Justice or Ministério do Interior page stating passport photo size/background specifications (as distinct from the visa specifications independently confirmed for tl-visa) could be located despite searching mj.gov.tl, timor-leste.gov.tl, and ajendamentu.mj.gov.tl.
